end.summary:
Khushi practised applying neutralisation to ant bites and acidic soil using a suitable base.
They identified baking soda and lime/chuna as bases in some responses.
The belief that acid and base always make poison remained at the last check.
The belief that plain water neutralises acid also remained at the last check; revisit antacids, toothpaste, factory waste and soil treatment next time.
end.parentNote: Khushi practised matching a suitable base to everyday acidic situations, including baking soda for an ant bite and lime for acidic soil. They used examples from the lesson and later returned to lime as the suitable treatment, but the mix-up that acid and base always make poison was not corrected by the last turn; adding plain water was also still being suggested. At home, ask Khushi to sort examples into “neutralisation with a suitable base” and “not neutralisation,” including antacids, toothpaste and factory waste.
